newsitem.title: GERMANY: Man holds hostages in German bank - police.
newsitem.headline: Man holds hostages in German bank - police.

text.p: A man took six hostages at a bank in southwestern Germany on Friday and threatened to shoot them unless he received a ransom of five million marks ($3 million), police said on Friday.
The man. who was not identified, set a deadline of 10 p.m. (2000 GMT) for his demands to be met, a police spokesman said.
He seized the hostages in the small town of Neuenstein, near Heidelberg, in the late afternoon. He also demanded a getaway car and said he would shoot the hostages if anyone went near the building.
A local radio station said the man had telephoned its office twice, confirming the ultimatum and saying one hostage would be shot every hour unless police met the deadline.
